title: The scalar direct-image mate is invertible on bounded-below complexes
statement: Let ell,E,T,U and normalized scalar realization data s_T,s_U satisfy [lem-weil-pbc-realization-scalar-functor], and let h:T→U be qcqs. Let c_A be the canonical completed coefficient comparison, let c_E be normalized continuous rational precomposition, and suppose the two scalar maps a_T,a_U commute with c_A,c_E. Let G_A,G_E be the corresponding ordinary ambient derived direct images and d:G_E Res_U≅Res_T G_A the specified coefficient-restriction comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. For every bounded-below complex K and every arrow b:Ext_U(G_A K)→G_E(Ext_T K) whose Ext_U⊣Res_U adjunct is G_A(eta_T(K)) followed by d^{-1}, b is an isomorphism. Neither derived completeness nor constructibility nor properness is assumed.

source.place: Bhatt--Scholze Lemma 6.8.2 and Remark 6.8.15; Hemo--Richarz--Scholbach Lemma 5.3(1)

proof.text:
the completed coefficient isomorphism identifies scalar extension with
localization of continuous integral coefficients at l. The DVR equation
l = unit times a positive uniformizer power identifies it with the displayed
rational inclusion. Express restricted extension as the multiplication-by-l
sequence, with nth leg l^(-n) times the adjunction unit. Exact filtered colimits
compute each cohomology sheaf of this telescope. Choose a good truncation of a
representative of K below its bound; every stage has the same lower bound.
Qcqs direct-image continuity computes the pushed telescope by the same colimit.
The adjunct equation for b gives equality of the zeroth legs after restriction
and the canonical coefficient direct-image comparison. Additivity and
invertibility of l on the localized vertices give equality of every leg.
Colimit uniqueness makes the restricted b invertible on every cohomology
sheaf, hence in the derived category. Exact coefficient restriction reflects
isomorphisms, proving the assertion without constructibility or properness.
